name: @vip/service-rules
description: Rules service (Phase 1, P1-7) — the automation brain. Consumes `event.persisted` off NATS JetStream and evaluates tenant-defined, versioned rules (a pure sandboxed predicate DSL over the EventEnvelope — never DetectionResult) with optional windowed thresholds (tenant-scoped state), emitting `incident.candidate` + `rule.matched`. Rule CRUD is versioned + audited; `POST /rules/:id/dry-run` has no side effects. Distinct from the Policy Engine (ADR-0013). See docs/architecture/phase1/RULE_ENGINE.md, 10-RULE-ENGINE.md.
